Kavita.PORT: Kavita web and API listener used by Railway health checks.
Kavita.KAVITA_DATA_DIR: Volume mount holding config/ (Kavita database and settings) and library/ (uploaded books). Must stay /data.
Kavita.UPLOAD_PORT: Private dufs upload server listener reached only through the gateway at /files/.

Kavita Gateway.GATEWAY_USERNAME: Username for first-admin setup and the /files/ upload manager.
Kavita Gateway.GATEWAY_PASSWORD: Generated password for first-admin setup and the /files/ upload manager.
Kavita Gateway.KAVITA_UPSTREAM: Private Kavita web and API endpoint.
Kavita Gateway.GATEWAY_CONFIG: Pinned Caddy policy: Basic Auth on setup and /files/, Kavita login everywhere else.
